method: Raw replay records are unchanged. Monitor passes additionally require the latest transcript's interpretation to finish before the replay observation window closes. WER/CER use NFKC, casefold, punctuation removal and whitespace normalization; number words are not converted to digits. CER counts Unicode code points excluding spaces, not grapheme clusters. Task-level target/counter accuracy remains primary.
